scope: Separately scoped source reconstruction by authorized researchers/data holder; agent receives only permitted development payloads and metadata

source.identity_authority: prior UCI packet; byte identity is not custody or acquisition proof
source.class_meanings: BLOCKED: require exact release-specific Result definition before any target construction
source.official_archive_acquisition: source-snapshot.json; current download authenticated against pinned archive SHA-256; no ARFF member payload opened

identity.source_row_id: zero-based logical ARFF data-record ordinal assigned before any screening; skip blank/comment lines, never renumber survivors

parsing.proposed_encoding: UTF-8-sig strict; optional BOM decoding only; abort on invalid encoding or unsupported syntax
parsing.columns: all 30 ordered native feature names followed by Result
parsing.validate: strict ARFF header/domains and each native integer; no missing-value substitution or ignored parse errors
parsing.candidate_implementation: ml.uci_reconstruction.reconstruct_candidate: in-memory bytes only; no source loader or real execution authorization

deduplication.policy: complete 31-value equality including native Result; retain earliest original record; reason every later exact copy
deduplication.digest_definition: ml.metadata.fingerprint of canonical JSON object {columns: ordered original field names, values: corresponding native integer list}; predictor digest uses only the 30 features
deduplication.mismatch_action: abort and investigate; never force historical counts by extra exclusions

custodian_receipt_requires: native-label preservation and independent class definition
retained/removed original locators and reason totals
ledger.construction: ml.uci_reconstruction.reconstruct_candidate; computes prefilter IDs, digests, exact duplicate dispositions and native-only retained rows

grouping.proposed_relationship: exact equality of all 30 native predictor codes, independent of native Result
grouping.mixed_target_policy_proposed: retain distinct complete records with differing native labels; keep equal-vector records in the same indivisible group; no relabeling or selective removal
grouping.other_relationships: domain/campaign/template identity unavailable unless custodian supplies authentic evidence; explicit limitation acceptance required
grouping.group_counts: must be measured; historical 5785/64 are comparison context, not required reconstructed truth

allocation.implementation: existing connected_groups/allocate under accepted relationship evidence and frozen settings
allocation.calibration_and_test: reserved groups isolated and unavailable to agent; no final evaluation authorized

exposure.known: historical UCI holdout evaluated; original snapshot includes historically exposed observations

features.prose_code_conflicts: Request_URL and Redirect require resolved or explicitly accepted limited interpretation

authorization_requirements: authentic source/release/class facts; obtain third-party evidence only when held externally
researcher approval of this prospective design and actual metadata
exact source/data-holder access scope; holder may be a researcher; never agent reserved-payload access
exact D-features receipt and independently trusted digest after accepted delivery
separate frozen E development fit authorization; none inferred from D
